figures.caption: Fig. 1. An overview of the proposed quality-guided semi-supervised segmentation methods, along with the scope of experiments present in this paper.

Table 1. Quantitative results (DSC and IoU; meanstd.err.) for all SSL baselines, their quality-weighted versions, and QAR. Using a quality predictor consistently improves segmentation performance across 5 datasets and 3 segmentation model architectures.

Fig. 2. Scatter plot of the segmentation predictions’ Dice DSC(y, ŷ) and the corresponding predicted quality estimates gϕ(x, ŷ) on the test set of CLI dataset, and four representative images (A-D) with the ground truth (green) and predicted (red) segmentations. We observe a strong, stat. sig., positive linear correlation (ρ=0.69; p=1e-314).
